sn12.46:1.2: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn12.46:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.46:2.1: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama so karoti so paṭisaṃvedayatīti.
sn12.46:2.2: so karoti so paṭisaṃvedayatīti kho brāhmaṇa ayameko anto.
sn12.46:3.1: kiṃ pana bho gotama añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedayatīti.
sn12.46:3.2: añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedayatīti kho brāhmaṇa ayaṃ dutiyo anto
sn12.46:3.3: ete te brāhmaṇa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti
sn12.46:4.1: evaṃ vutte so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn12.46:4.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama …pe…
sn12.46:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
